mentions.name: TinyServe
mentions.description: TinyServe is a self-hosted hosting solution for single-user projects, built on a Mac mini M4 kept in a basement. It pairs a CLI with a daemon to automate everything around running the box, with Cloudflare used for security hardening at the start.
mentions.audience: Struggled to find a compelling hosting solution for projects that only has and will have only a single user for years.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://tinyserve.org

Recently, I've been very motivated to make one niche crafted service after another. For myself, family and friends. But struggled to find a compelling hosting solution for projects that only has and will have only a single user for years.  
I bought the cheapest mac mini M4 on sale, put it in basement and started working on some cli+daemon to help me automate all things around it. 
The biggest risk is security, so probably gonna rely a lot on Cloudflare at start.
